subject.title: fix: preserve BOOTSTRAP.md in preseeded workspaces (#91931)

question: Should pending BOOTSTRAP.md with no setupCompletedAt require concrete user-content or deletion evidence, instead of accepting profile-file diffs or preseeded workspace skills as completion evidence?
rationale: The patch fixes the managed-workspace bug by narrowing a shipped completion heuristic, but that changes setup-state behavior for existing pending workspaces and needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept narrowed pending-bootstrap rule
options.body: Land after the test and docs repairs, treating profile diffs and preseeded skills as insufficient while BOOTSTRAP.md is still pending.

options.title: Require an explicit managed mode
options.body: Ask for a config or migration design if legacy profile-diff repair must remain the default behavior for existing workspaces.

options.title: Pause for broader bootstrap policy
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR if maintainers want a larger redesign of bootstrap completion semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept narrowed pending-bootstrap rule
recommendation.body: Land after the test and docs repairs, treating profile diffs and preseeded skills as insufficient while BOOTSTRAP.md is still pending.
